scripts.build: npm run build -w @resolve/contracts && npm run build -w @resolve/api && npm run build -w @resolve/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @resolve/contracts && npm run check -w @resolve/api && npm run check -w @resolve/web && eslint . && prettier --check .
scripts.test: npm run build -w @resolve/contracts && npm run test -w @resolve/api && npm run test -w @resolve/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @resolve/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @resolve/api
